summary: Dog Star Man is a series of short experimental films directed by Stan Brakhage and featuring Jane Wodening. The work was released between 1961 and 1964 and consists of a prelude and four parts.
one_line: Dog Star Man is a 1961–1964 experimental film series by Stan Brakhage, featuring Jane Wodening, made of a prelude and four parts.
